package.description: Secure, resilient access to private applications, cloud services, and websites for Windows.

en-US.description: Secure, resilient access to private applications, cloud services, and websites for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: Absolute Secure Access provides secure, resilient Zero Trust connections to private applications, cloud services, and websites for hybrid, mobile, and field workers. Its Windows client is designed to be self-healing and support policy enforcement, threat protection, and visibility.
en-US.name: Absolute Secure Access Client

zh-CN.description: 为 Windows 提供安全、稳定的私有应用、云服务和网站访问。
zh-CN.longDescription: Absolute Secure Access 为混合办公、移动办公和现场工作人员提供连接私有应用、云服务和网站的安全、稳定的零信任连接。其 Windows 客户端支持自我修复，并提供策略执行、威胁防护和可视性。
